name: Game Boy / Game Boy Color
verified: Runs on the Tang Nano 20K (HDMI + LCD). Return to the launcher via RECONFIG_N is being added.
image_note: Menu on the real board, over the UART screen stream

name: WonderSwan / WonderSwan Color
verified: Builds for the Tang Nano 20K at about 75 percent of the LUTs. Return hook not built yet.

name: CHIP-8
verified: All 35 opcodes. The whole frame matches an independent reference interpreter in simulation. The board bitstream builds and meets timing (pixel clock 82 MHz at 74.25 needed). Board screenshot pending.

name: Pong
verified: Game logic matches a reference model after 900 steps; the UART screenshot stream matches in a top-level simulation. Bitstream meets timing. Board screenshot pending.

name: Apple I
verified: 6502 passes 200 of 200 random-program comparisons with a reference (binary and decimal). A monitor session through the UART matches a reference model screen. Bitstream meets timing (pixel clock 108 MHz at 74.25 needed). Board screenshot pending.

name: Breakout
verified: Game logic matches an independent reference model in simulation (5 checkpoints, whole frame). Runs on the Tang Nano 20K, started from flash slot A through the launcher's multiboot jump; frame captured over the UART. HDMI output not yet checked on a display.
image_note: Real capture from the board over the UART

name: Sega Master System / Game Gear
verified: Scaffold only: upstream HDL and a porting audit. Nothing synthesised for the GW2AR-18 yet. No screenshot until a frame exists.

name: ColecoVision / SG-1000
verified: Core logic (Z80, TMS9918, SN76489, AY) converts with GHDL and synthesises: about 5 700 LUT4, 30 percent of the device. No top level or board run yet. No screenshot until a frame exists.
